summary: This is a simple SVG image that draws a red circle in the center of a 100×100 pixel canvas. The circle has a radius of 40 pixels and is positioned at the exact center point.

explanations.1: The svg tag is the container for all vector graphics; width and height define the canvas size in pixels, and xmlns declares this as an SVG document so browsers know how to render it.
explanations.2: The circle element draws a circle; cx and cy are the center coordinates (50,50 puts it in the middle of our 100×100 canvas), r is the radius, and fill colors it red.
